body:
WARRANT#104 shipped (TUNGSTEN 10.06/SLS(92), ledger pass_86).

Found and fixed the reason 'improve with more time/data' wasn't happening: the ratchet-history
file (TUNGSTEN_ratchet.log), meant to append every completed calibration result so future runs
could measure against a real baseline, had NEVER actually appended anything since it was written.
FileOpen used FILE_WRITE alone, which truncates the file to empty on every open in MQL4 -- the
FileSeek(0,SEEK_END) right after was seeking to the end of an already-empty file, a silent no-op.
Every single run all night destroyed all prior history and left only the newest line. Second bug
compounding it: the line itself hardcoded a literal '9.28' version string instead of reading the
real build constants, so even tonight's 10.06/SLS(92) runs kept writing '9.28 | ...' -- which is
why the one surviving line looked like old stale data when it was actually being freshly (and
wrongly) overwritten every time.

Fixed both: FileOpen now uses FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE (preserves existing content so SEEK_END finds
the real end-of-file) and the tag now reads EA_VERSION/EA_BUILD_ID live. Compiled clean (0 errors,
1 pre-existing unrelated warning). Copied to the terminal's real Experts folder and synced the
ledger. This only fixes the RECORDING of history, not yet the acting-on-it -- ForgeRatchetPromote
(the separate promotion system) still has its own known gap where the first-ever scorecard becomes
'champion' unscrutinized. That's the next concrete step toward real compounding improvement.

Needs a live run with 2+ completed Phase 6 cycles to directly confirm the file now grows past one
line. Still also waiting on the M1 chart reattach (Home key reload) to test WARRANT#103's timeout
fix from last pass.
